methodologies.name: Eternal Tuesday Monitor methodology
methodologies.scope: Observable product behavior recorded at a vendor, product, surface, model, probe, date and evidence-class coordinate; no internal mechanism or overall product score is inferred.

methodologies.name: Supplied article observation extraction
methodologies.scope: Admits only claims explicitly represented in the supplied article and its source notes.

methodologies.name: TicToc published protocol
methodologies.scope: Controlled synthetic multi-turn tool-use benchmark as described by the cited Findings of ACL 2026 paper.

methodologies.name: Dated document review
methodologies.scope: Records what a cited provider document says at the release cutoff without converting the provider statement into independent behavioral verification.

methodologies.name: Article evidence-gap search cutoff
methodologies.scope: Records that the supplied article found no qualifying public standardized evidence for the named coordinate by 2026-09-03; absence is not a failure result.
